== Problem == Aunt Anna is 42 years old. Caitlin is 5 years younger than Brianna, and Brianna is half as old as Aunt Anna. How old is Caitlin? \mathrm{(A)}\ 15\qquad\mathrm{(B)}\ 16\qquad\mathrm{(C)}\ 17\qquad\mathrm{(D)}\ 21\qquad\mathrm{(E)}\ 37 ==Solution== Brianna is \frac{1}{2} \cdot 42 = 21 years old, so Caitlin is 21-5=\boxed{\textbf{(B)}\ 16} years old. ==See Also== {{AMC8 box|year=2000|before=First
Question|num-a=2}} {{MAA Notice}}
